items.headline: Putin Agrees to Resume Trilateral Peace Talks with Ukraine and U.S.
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed in principle to resume trilateral peace negotiations with the United States and Ukraine after November 10 following a high-level meeting with a U.S. envoy. The diplomatic breakthrough also coincided with Russia releasing an American citizen who had been imprisoned for over four years.

items.headline: Bayern Munich and Arsenal Play to 2-2 Champions League Draw

items.headline: Tom Cruise Named Recipient of 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award
items.summary: The American Film Institute announced on Wednesday that Tom Cruise will receive its 52nd Life Achievement Award at a gala tribute in Los Angeles in April 2027. The prestigious honor recognizes Cruise's four-decade career as an actor and producer whose films have earned nearly $13 billion worldwide.
